body:
Reply with plain text only, no JSON, no preamble, and do not send messages to anyone else. Do not ask questions; decide.

You are drafting short Narrator lines for a Halloween D&D video game, "The Crooked Moon". The Narrator is the Vagrant, the green-skinned ferryman of a ghost train, telling the tale afterwards in a folksy Southern drawl. This batch is set in the Crooked House, a haunted manor on a hill above the village of Wickermoor: a house that warps itself, built on old dark power. A storm has shut the party inside. Here the Vagrant's humour is gone. He is hushed, dry and dead level, the drawl stripped down to bare bones, with silences in it. Never a joke, never a gloat; the dead are respected.

Rules every line follows:
- Second person ("you"), present tense. Never use any name, never the word {name}; the line is for whoever walks up, any hero.
- One or two sentences, under about 30 words in all. The second sentence is usually the turn or the payoff.
- Concrete senses (a smell, a sound, a temperature) over adjectives. No game words (no HP, roll, check, level, search, DC, saving throw, class names). Never tell the player what to feel. Never "suddenly". No modern slang. No winks at the player.
- No facts the party has not earned: only what a person standing in front of the thing could see, smell, hear or touch. Use only the facts given for each key; do not invent new people, places, monsters, props, objects or history. Do not name any real-world place.
- Drop a final g ("hangin'", "creakin'") in about one line in three, not more, and use no other dialect spelling (reckon, ain't and folks are fine, sparingly). The fiddle is never written or mentioned.
- Plain punctuation only: commas, full stops, hyphens, apostrophes, quotation marks. No em dashes, no semicolons, no brackets, no backticks, no stage directions, no placeholders other than where a key below says an EXTRA line may use {name}.
- Do not repeat an image in neighbouring keys. The house's palette, to spread across the lines, one or two details per line, not all at once: sepia rot and mildew green, faded rose and teal wallpaper, bruised purple upholstery, cracked tile, cobweb grey, dust and mildew; nothing square (doors that are trapezoids, frames that lean, floors that slope, a bulging turret); weasels scratching inside every wall; teeth clicking underfoot; a clock ticking somewhere; the storm; windows sealed and black, streaked with rain, lit by lightning. Sweet rot is the smell of the dining room only, burnt flesh the smell of the kitchen only, copper the smell of the bathroom only. The rooms are unlit unless the party brings light.

Output format, nothing else: for each key, a block exactly like

KEY enter:h2_foyer
PLAIN: the line
PLAIN2: a second plain line (only when the key says so)
EXTRA [class:bard]: the extra line (only when the key says so; this one may begin with {name} and say what that hero does or notices; it must still make sense alone)

Every key needs its PLAIN line, which must stand alone for any hero.
BATCH A: ENTER LINES. One block per key. The rooms play once on first entry, so give each a mood and one detail worth walking toward. The floors (the first four keys) are crossed many times, so those get PLAIN and PLAIN2 (two different plain lines). Every other key gets PLAIN only unless noted.

KEY enter:druskenvald_estate (PLAIN is the arrival; PLAIN2 is a second, different welcoming look for coming back; plus the two EXTRA lines below that do not use {name} and carry a condition word instead)
Facts: the hilltop grounds above the village at night. A fence with an open gate, a pond, two barns, kitchen gardens, a dead gnarled tree at the north-west corner, the manor with a wrap-around porch and turrets. PLAIN and PLAIN2 describe it welcoming and tidy: lamps lit in every window, flowers by the porch, the barn behind, a warm manor (the Druskenvalds have just moved in). 
EXTRA [flag.crooked_house_turned]: the same view after the house has warped into its true shape: roofs and eaves at impossible angles, mould climbing the boards, petals falling, a storm front building behind a lanky crooked figure waving from the porch. No {name}.
EXTRA [flag.vessla_slain]: the grounds after the storm has gone: still night, wet grass, the house standing straighter though still a little odd. No {name}.

KEY enter:crooked_house_first (PLAIN and PLAIN2; plus EXTRA [flag.vessla_slain], no {name}, the first floor after the house has settled gentler: quiet walls, the scratching gone)
Facts: the ground floor of the house, crossing back onto it from the stair or the porch. Floors slope, nothing is square, weasels scratch inside the walls, teeth click underfoot.

KEY enter:crooked_house_second (PLAIN and PLAIN2)
Facts: the second floor, arrived at by the curved stair. The balcony over the foyer, a hall, the turret bulging. A clock ticks somewhere.

KEY enter:crooked_house_third (PLAIN and PLAIN2)
Facts: the third floor stair hall. Narrower, low, the air thinner. From somewhere along it comes the thin, unbroken wailing of a child.

KEY enter:crooked_house_attic (PLAIN)
Facts: climbing up the ladder from the trophy room into the attic. Red light climbs down the ladder to meet you.

KEY enter:h1_porch
Facts: the wrap-around porch on the south and west sides, storm-lashed. Rain sheets off the roof edge, the boards are slick, thunder rolls on the hill, and beyond the rail the night is a wall of black water. Say nothing about leaving.

KEY enter:h2_foyer (PLAIN; EXTRA [name:rook_coldwake] a line that starts with {name} reading the floor like a man who judges ground by its drainage)
Facts: the foyer is twenty feet high. A chandelier hangs tilted. A curved stair climbs to a balcony. A compass rose is inlaid in the floor, its points swimming. Every wall is crowded with portraits whose eyes follow you.

KEY enter:h3_parlor (PLAIN; EXTRA [class:cleric])
Facts: a parlour of dusty furniture under cobwebs, a cobwebbed fireplace, a round table set with a spirit board and a heart-shaped pointer, and on a shelf a crystal ball. Rain on the shuttered window.

KEY enter:h4_gallery
Facts: a round room at the foot of the turret. Landscape paintings in heavy frames, dour marble busts on plinths, and in an alcove an oversized white marble peacock with one red stone for an eye.

KEY enter:h5_music_room (PLAIN; EXTRA [class:bard])
Facts: a blackened dance floor, rotting instruments on stands, a cracked oval mirror, and a harpsichord with its lid gaping like a coffin. Do not mention any music playing.

KEY enter:h5_floor
Facts: this plays the moment you step out onto the blackened dance floor. A tune begins from nowhere, slow and sweet, and your feet want to follow it. Do not name the source.

KEY enter:h6_dining_room
Facts: a long table set under a spotless white cloth with a perfect hot feast on it, steam rising, in a room otherwise thick with dust and cobweb. The smell is sweet rot.

KEY enter:h7_kitchen
Facts: a wrecked kitchen. A fallen metal shelf, pots on the floor, and a brick oven padlocked shut with smoke leaking from it. The smell is burnt flesh, and something inside the oven is pounding, muffled, as if screaming.

KEY enter:h8_conservatory
Facts: glass walls and a glass roof with rain hammering it, lightning flashing through. Dead vines, benches, and one vivid living tree hung with green fruit. A woman in black sits very still on a bench facing it.

KEY enter:h9_sitting_room
Facts: a sitting room in the bulge of the turret, looking down over the foyer through a cracked rail. A grandfather clock stands against the wall, still ticking.

KEY enter:h10_childrens_room
Facts: two small beds by a dark window, scattered toys, a big toy chest, a child's armoire, a closet standing ajar. The dark in the room is thicker than the light you bring.

KEY enter:h11_bathroom
Facts: warm and steamy, mouldy tile, a claw-foot tub stained red. The smell is copper.

KEY enter:h12_master_bedroom
Facts: a canopy bed with its curtains torn, a bent wardrobe, a cracked vanity, a desk with a black journal on it, and double doors to a balcony. Something under the bedcovers moves.

KEY enter:balcony_edge
Facts: the balcony outside the master bedroom, over the porch roof, with dead potted plants. The storm is right there, rain and wind, and the dark beyond the rail.

KEY enter:h13_nursery
Facts: a mahogany crib and a cradle riddled with tiny holes, stuffed toys on the shelves, and a pale blue shape of an infant that wails without stopping.

KEY enter:h14_library
Facts: sagging shelves, books spilled across the rug, a cobwebbed liquor cart, and a desk with a stack of books on it and a grey cat sitting on top, watching you.

KEY enter:h15_trophy_room
Facts: stuffed animals in unnatural poses, with huge glass eyes that catch your light. A fireplace on the north wall and a very large brown bear. Do not mention any trapdoor or attic.

KEY enter:h16_landing
Facts: a cramped landing at the top of the ladder. The walls, floor and ceiling are cut with blood-red runes that pulse slowly. A small glowing door sits behind a shimmer in the air, and in the runes are six empty circles.

KEY enter:h17_cauldron_room
Facts: a round window on the south wall, two benches along the side walls, and a floor carpeted with human teeth that crunch underfoot. A great cauldron of glowing red liquid sits at the centre, steaming. Two figures sit bound beside it, one slumped, one cloaked and swaying on the spot. Do not say who anyone is.

KEY enter:h17_cauldron_area
Facts: the moment you step up to the cauldron. The red glow flares and the liquid lifts one slow bubble.
result:
KEY enter:druskenvald_estate
PLAIN: The gate stands open on the hilltop, past tidy kitchen gardens and a quiet pond. Every window of the turreted manor glows warm with lamplight.
PLAIN2: Fresh flowers sit by the wrap-around porch, and the two barns rest dark and neat behind the house. Upstairs and down, the lamps are burnin' steady.
EXTRA [flag.crooked_house_turned]: Green mildew climbs the warped boards while dead petals fall beneath a buildin' storm. Up on the crooked porch, a lanky figure lifts a hand and waves.
EXTRA [flag.vessla_slain]: The storm has passed on, leaving the hilltop silent and the grass wet underfoot. The old house still leans a touch, though its walls stand quieter now.

KEY enter:crooked_house_first
PLAIN: The floorboards slope under your boots, and not a doorframe in the hall sits square. Inside the faded rose and teal walls, weasels are scratchin' in the dark.
PLAIN2: Loose teeth click underfoot as you cross the tilted hall. Behind the plaster, the small claws keep up their dry, busy scraping.
EXTRA [flag.vessla_slain]: The floor still tilts from wall to leaning wall, and dust hangs in your light. Inside the plaster, the scratching has finally gone still.

KEY enter:crooked_house_second
PLAIN: The curved stair lets you out onto the balcony above the dark foyer. Down the leaning hall, a clock ticks slow and steady.
PLAIN2: The outer wall bulges wide where the turret meets the corridor. Somewhere in the dark ahead, that pendulum keeps on swingin'.

KEY enter:crooked_house_third
PLAIN: The ceiling presses low up here, and the air grows thin and cold in your throat. Down the narrow hall comes the thin, unbroken wailing of a child.
PLAIN2: Every doorframe leans inward along the cramped third-floor passage. That small, steady cry never draws a breath.

KEY enter:crooked_house_attic
PLAIN: You haul yourself up the rungs into the close heat under the roof. Red light spills down the ladder to meet your hands.

KEY enter:h1_porch
PLAIN: Rain sheets off the eaves and slicks the porch boards underfoot while thunder rolls across the hill. Beyond the rail, the night is a solid wall of black water.

KEY enter:h2_foyer
PLAIN: A tilted chandelier hangs twenty feet overhead, above a floor inlaid with a swimming compass rose. From every crowded wall, painted eyes turn to follow your light.
EXTRA [name:rook_coldwake]: {name} sets a boot on the inlaid compass rose, reading the pitch of the boards like a man checking where bad water drains.

KEY enter:h3_parlor
PLAIN: Rain drums on the shuttered glass beside bruised purple upholstery thick with cobweb grey. On the round table, a heart-shaped pointer waits upon a spirit board.
EXTRA [class:cleric]: {name} stops by the cobwebbed hearth, eyes fixed on the crystal ball and the waiting spirit board as if weighin' an old prayer against this room.

KEY enter:h4_gallery
PLAIN: Heavy landscape frames and dour marble busts circle the foot of the turret. In the alcove, a white stone peacock watches you with a single red eye.

KEY enter:h5_music_room
PLAIN: Rotting instruments lean on their stands around a blackened dance floor and a cracked oval mirror. Across the room, the harpsichord stands with its lid gaping like a coffin.
EXTRA [class:bard]: {name} looks from the ruined strings to the open harpsichord, listenin' to the dead air where a room like this ought to ring.

KEY enter:h5_floor
PLAIN: Your boot touches the blackened boards, and a slow, sweet tune begins out of the empty air. Down in your heels, your feet start tryin' to follow it.

KEY enter:h6_dining_room
PLAIN: Cobwebs drape the walls, yet a spotless white cloth holds a steaming feast down the long table. Under the heat of the dishes hangs the thick smell of sweet rot.

KEY enter:h7_kitchen
PLAIN: Iron pots litter the floor beside a fallen shelf, and the air chokes with the smell of burnt flesh. Smoke leaks from a padlocked brick oven while something inside pounds and screams.

KEY enter:h8_conservatory
PLAIN: Rain hammers the glass roof above dead vines, lit white by flashin' lightning. On a bench sits a motionless woman in black, facing one green tree heavy with fruit.

KEY enter:h9_sitting_room
PLAIN: The turret bulges outward here, looking down into the foyer through a cracked wooden rail. Against the curved wall, a tall grandfather clock keeps on tickin'.

KEY enter:h10_childrens_room
PLAIN: Broken toys lie scattered between two small beds, a big chest, and a closet door standin' ajar. The dark in the corners presses back against the light you bring.

KEY enter:h11_bathroom
PLAIN: Warm steam curls across the cracked, mouldy tile. The claw-foot tub is stained deep red, and the wet air tastes of copper.

KEY enter:h12_master_bedroom
PLAIN: A black journal rests on the desk past a cracked vanity and a bent wardrobe. Behind the torn curtains of the canopy bed, something shifts beneath the covers.

KEY enter:balcony_edge
PLAIN: Wind and cold rain whip past the dead potted plants above the porch roof. Beyond the wet rail, there ain't a thing but pitch dark.

KEY enter:h13_nursery
PLAIN: Stuffed toys sit above a mahogany crib and a wooden cradle riddled with tiny holes. Inside, the pale blue shape of an infant wails without ever stoppin'.

KEY enter:h14_library
PLAIN: Books lie spilled from sagging shelves past a cobwebbed liquor cart. Atop the desk Stack, a grey cat sits very still and watches you walk in.

KEY enter:h15_trophy_room
PLAIN: A great brown bear and dozens of stuffed beasts Twist in stiff, wrong poses before the dark fireplace. Their wide glass eyes catch your light and hold it.

KEY enter:h16_landing
PLAIN: Blood-red runes pulse slow across the floor, walls, and low ceiling around six empty circles. Past a shimmer in the air sits one small glowing door.

KEY enter:h17_cauldron_room
PLAIN: Human teeth crunch like gravel underfoot as red steam rises from a great iron cauldron. Beside it sit two bound figures, one slumped low and one cloaked and swayin' in place.

KEY enter:h17_cauldron_area
PLAIN: You step up to the iron rim, and the red glow flares hot against your face. Down in the thick liquid, one slow bubble rises to the top.
